description: Footpaths in City of Casey (T1EAM) is a dataset listed in City of Casey's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Casey. The locations and width of footpaths in City of Casey, extracted from the City of Casey's Asset Management System (OneCouncil) and GIS databases. Coverage: City of Casey, Victoria. The portal files it under Assets, Environmental, Transport. Its keywords are Shared Use Path, Footpaths. The portal shows 28,571 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-casey-vic-gov-au-portal.
